scope: Pinned upstream left/right source mechanics, explicit right-hand definition selection, compiled mechanical cross-check and mounting-frame observations. Dynamic acceptance is separate.

adopted_right_definition.mechanical_authority: DH116-R000-A1 URDF at the pinned commit; all 17 link masses, inertial origins/full tensors and 16 joint parent/child/type/origin/axis/limits are preserved
adopted_right_definition.rotation_convention: URDF rpy is Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll), converted to MuJoCo wxyz quaternion; source MJCF eulerseq=XYZ uses the same fixed-axis convention
adopted_right_definition.coupling_authority: URDF linear mimic: follower = offset + multiplier * driver; the upstream MJCF quadratic terms are not used

position_actuators.ctrlrange_source: right URDF joint lower and upper limits

model_options_and_7_arm_motors.rule: preserved together with all robot0_/mount0_ mechanical and physical attributes

collision.engine_representation: MuJoCo convex hull for each mesh
collision.limitation: convex hulls do not reproduce concave triangle surfaces; geometric source fidelity does not establish dynamic/contact acceptance

initial_state.arm_qpos: first 7 entries of the left composite keyframe

adopted_right_definition.interface_metadata: existing zero-mass gripper0_eef, three base sites and force/torque sensor references; these are application metadata, not additional manufacturer mechanical links
adopted_right_definition.source_effort_velocity: URDF effort=0 and velocity=0 are retained in the source file; these do not provide validated actuator capabilities and are not imposed as zero force limits
adopted_right_definition.equivalence_claim: The assembled variant uses URDF mechanics/linear coupling plus separately attributed source-MJCF simulation parameters. It is not claimed to be equivalent to the complete upstream MJCF model.

mesh_units.interpretation: source numeric coordinates are used as meters by the source models; no millimeter-to-meter rescaling is applied
source numeric coordinates are used as meters by the source models; no millimeter-to-meter rescaling is applied

right_compiled_mechanical_cross_check.rule: direct equality of each compiled field; no tolerance relaxation for these source-to-generated comparisons

full_inertia_validation.primary_check: all six generated XML fullinertia components equal the source URDF components exactly
full_inertia_validation.diagnostic_only: MuJoCo 3.2.3 diagonalization/reconstruction has observed maximum absolute tensor residual 1.66118465060509e-11 in both source and generated models; the 2e-11 reconstruction threshold is a numerical diagnostic, not proof of physical equivalence

mounting_frame_observations.scope: Source mounting-frame geometry supports a common origin/face convention; no bolt tolerance or exact concave interference fit is validated.

source_observations.impact: manufacturer actuation capability unspecified; do not use zero as validated physical capability
fixed pieces must not create additional DOFs
